items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I don't know, man. I'm just out there looking at the facts... all of a sudden I get the bill from Atlantic Records for $40,000, for the cost of the musicians... Joan -- what's her name, Joan what? Gets $600,000 in advance.

ctx.x: I don't know, man. I'm just out there looking at the facts, that I make a record date, I'm doing what I want to do, and all of a sudden I get the bill from Atlantic Records for $40,000, for the cost of the musicians. And I'm not getting but four or five myself. When am I going to make some money? I'm trying to find out where (inaudible) Joan -- what's her name, Joan what? Gets $600,000 in advance.

Yeah, she gets $600,000 in advance. And it's only because I'm black, man. I had a record date I got you for, was supposed to do, (inaudible) for Columbia, remember the one [real]. with (singing), the thing I wrote, the one I did for them.
